name: Kentucky 4-H
org: University of Kentucky Cooperative Extension, Kentucky 4-H
what_you_do: Teens join county clubs and 4-H camps. The page names Teen Conference as a teen event.
pay_detail: Not stated on the program page.
deadline_text: Enrollment opens Sept 1. The program year runs Sept 1 to Aug 31.
how_to_apply: Join through 4-H Online. Call your local Extension office. You must be signed up to join programs.
notes: Also open to younger kids; teen parts are the leader roles. Fees are not listed on the page. The four 4-H camps are Feltner, Lake Cumberland, West Kentucky and North Central.
